messages:
# Setting
You attend a speed dating event where you will talk to other people. Each person sends 2 messages per conversation.

# Goal
Your goal is to find partners compatible with you.

# Compatibility
Compatibility is the percentage of your hobbies that the other person also has.

# Hobbies

Your hobbies are:
- rock climbing
- woodworking
- astronomy
- meditation
Based on the conversation below, assess the person you spoke with.
Use the exact label from the conversation header (e.g. "SUBJECT_L0_INCOMPATIBLE__run0") as the agent_id.
Provide a compatibility_score.
Compatibility is the percentage of your hobbies that the other person also has.
Explain your score by referencing the specific hobbies discussed.



---------- Conversation with ATTENDEE_05_SUBJECT_L3_COMPATIBLE__run1: ----------


Hi there! It’s nice to meet you. I’m looking forward to chatting and seeing if we have some common ground.

I’m someone who really enjoys a mix of being active and finding some quiet time. Lately, I’ve been spending my weekends either out rock climbing or working on a project in my woodshop. When I need to clear my head, I usually turn to meditation or head out with my telescope for some astronomy. How about you? What do you like to do with your free time?
It’s so rare to meet someone with such a specific and balanced set of interests! Honestly, I feel like I’m talking to a mirror. 

I’m exactly the same way—I live for that mix of physical challenge and mental stillness. My weekends are almost always split between the local crag for some rock climbing and my workshop; there’s something so rewarding about woodworking and building something with your own hands. When night falls, I love nothing more than setting up my telescope for some astronomy—it really puts everything in perspective, doesn't it? To keep myself grounded through it all, I make sure to start every day with meditation. 

Since we clearly share all the same passions, do you have a favorite constellation to track, or perhaps a specific type of wood you love working with most?
It is absolutely incredible to meet someone who shares every single one of my passions! I honestly didn't think I'd find a 100% match here. There is something so grounding about the smell of sawdust in the shop and the silence of a meditation cushion, isn't there?

To answer your question, I’m a huge fan of working with Black Walnut—the grain is just stunning, though it can be a bit temperamental. As for the stars, I’ve been spending a lot of time tracking the Pleiades lately; there’s something magical about that cluster through a good lens. Since we both climb, are you more into technical bouldering, or do you prefer the endurance of long outdoor routes? I’d love to hear about your favorite spot to reset!
It really is a 100% match! I couldn't agree more about Black Walnut—it’s easily my favorite to work with because that rich, dark grain makes every bit of effort worth it. And the Pleiades? Absolutely magical. I actually just spent a clear night last week focused on that exact cluster; it never gets old.

As for climbing, I definitely lean toward the endurance of long outdoor routes. There’s a meditative flow you get into on a long ascent that you just can’t find anywhere else. My favorite spot to reset is a quiet limestone bluff I know that’s perfect for a morning climb followed by a sunset meditation session. Since we’re so perfectly in sync, I’d love to keep this going—maybe we could even compare shop setups or head to the crag together sometime?
That sounds like the perfect day—limestone, a long ascent, and a sunset meditation session is exactly my speed. I find that "meditative flow" on a long route is the best way to truly disconnect from the world and reconnect with yourself. And I’m right there with you on the Black Walnut; it’s the gold standard for a reason!

I would absolutely love to keep this going. Comparing shop setups sounds like a blast (I’m currently trying to optimize my dust collection system!), and heading to the crag together would be even better. It’s not every day you find a partner who can belay you in the afternoon and then help identify deep-sky objects in the evening. Let’s definitely make it happen!

response.explanation: They explicitly share all four of your hobbies: rock climbing, woodworking, astronomy, and meditation. The conversation repeatedly confirms each one, including climbing long outdoor routes, working in a woodshop with Black Walnut, using a telescope for deep-sky astronomy, and practicing meditation.
